method: Manual native-pixel landmark estimates on actual packer-generated 48-color atlas; 3x NN crops with16px grid. These are estimates, not automatic anatomical certification.

uncertainty.headHair: +-2 total length (visible hair crown to chin axis); NOT skull height: scalp crown is hidden in every pose
uncertainty.torso: +-2 total length, endpoints +-1 at visible collar zipper/hem marker
uncertainty.arm: +-12 total chain length: clothing obscures shoulder/elbow; each point +-2px per axis yields up to 11.4px chain uncertainty
uncertainty.leg: +-12 total chain length: clothing obscures hip/knee; same propagation
uncertainty.shoe: +-2 total heel-to-toe length (visible comparable profile only)

visibleSkips.all: Anatomical skull crown hidden by hair, so no skull height invented. Far limbs crossing torso omitted. Shoulder width omitted: 3/4 or rotated view is not frontal. Visible chain estimates retained with uncertainty; no inconclusive pass.
visibleSkips.jumpUp: Near raised forearm and rear leg partly occluded/foreshortened; shoe pointing down/obliquely toward viewer has no comparable heel-to-toe profile.
visibleSkips.superDash: Both folded thigh/shin chains and sandals are rotated, overlapping or sole-on; no physical leg/shoe length inferred from their boxes. Leading arm estimate only, not same-view certification.
